_: Timed windows and what they open and close, read by server/events.py (its docstring has the format): windows (daily times, windows laid over another's openings, calendar dates), spawns (the creatures of a location's own file that stand only while a window is open), held_out (of a file's own, never), quests (rows on offer only while a window is open), loot (a thing creatures carry in certain places), keep_in (things that exist in certain places only). The clock is the bosses' (server/bosses.py: Moscow time, LAVA_BOSS_CLOCK for a test), and nothing here is remembered: a server restarted in a window is in it. The bosses keep the owner's 14/18/22 (bosses.py); the rest keeps the times the map labels and the texts give. Every row says whether it is RECOVERED or DESIGNED.

prison_wh.why: RECOVERED. The uprising in Вади-Хальфа's prison (m8, the blocks 644-648 under the yard 176, 5985,1744): the yard's map label «Усиление режима в 12:00, 16:00 и 23:00» (res/database/locations.xml; the wiki's «Тюрьма Вади-Хальфы» the same), and the guard's call 62258: «каждый день в 12:00, 16:00 и 23:00 заключенным требуется усиленная охрана, длится это безобразие недолго, всего пол часа», its hint «"Охранять" заключенных нужно в течение 30 минут» (62272). The prisoners and the godfather stand while it is open. Not the bosses' 14/18/22: the owner's rule is for world bosses and camp chiefs, and the prison keeps the times its label gives.

prison_wh_gates.why: RECOVERED lead, DESIGNED end. The gates of the prison open a quarter of an hour before the uprising -- the label's «прибывать за 15 минут» -- and stay open while it lasts: the guards' ways into the blocks (161, 162), the station's ride to the yard (159) and the guard's hand-in of the invitation (158).

prison_wh_medics.why: RECOVERED. The medics who pay for the armbands, Джеф, Аль-Назир and Томпсон (877-879, the centre block 646), come for the last five minutes: «Сдать задание можно медикам, они появятся за 5 минут до завершения турнира» (62272, 62273).

wh_box.why: RECOVERED. The money boxes of Вади-Хальфа's three склады 109-111: the map labels' «Дележ добычи с 19:00 до 20:00» (res/database/locations.xml 315-317). Opens the holders' daily rows (data/holdings.json, server/holdings.py); the boss keeps the owner's 14, 18 and 22 (bosses.py), so a clan collects at seven and defends at two, six or ten.

ny.why: RECOVERED dates, the owner's default (plan, decision 22): the New Year «План Новогодних праздников» (62256) runs from «20 декабря» (the towns' trees) to «15 января 2016 года — Отключение новогодних квестов». Nothing of Вади-Хальфа's band stands by it yet: of the band's New Year residents, the children 423/425, the refugee 1977 and the lottery men 662/711 stand all year by the owner's default 5 (server/world.py SEASON_KEPT), Ольсен 431 stands nowhere (the default names him, but SEASON_KEPT leaves him out of 35 and 104 until his stall has goods of its own), the tree and Дед Мороз's company (Npc_Commoner000780-797) stand in no file, and the rest of the event runs through Донгола and the admin bunkers. Абри's band has two (the owner's Абри, 2026-10-12): the New Year of 2014's Дайсон and Канализационный люк (2426, 2427) in the Жилой квартал 188, who stood there all year until then (their token 'ng' is none of world.EVENT_TOKENS) and now stand in this window only (spawns, below).

may9.why: RECOVERED dates, the owner's default (plan, decision 22): from Victory Day to «Заказы принимаю до 2 августа» (46792-46800). The band's copy, 9may_*_WH (539-546, 571, 994, 995, level 6), is not stood in here: no way into it is recorded, its fighters' slots are empty, and its documents and awards have no item types found (see the handoff).

halloween.why: RECOVERED dates, the owner's default (plan, decision 22; the wiki's «Halloween 2015»). No creature of the band the client can draw belongs to it: the catacombs HW_cotakomb_*_WH put down types mobs.xml does not have.

feb23.why: DESIGNED dates, the owner's default (plan, decision 22: a week around the day). Its content (48959-48961, fevral23_exit 988 at 5851,1991) is around Абри and Мероэ, none of it in Вади-Хальфа's band.

spawns.why: RECOVERED creatures and place, the window's time. The prisoners m8_uf_Competitor_1..5 («Заключенный», 60388; the wiki's «Северный блок» lists «Заключенный») in the northern cells (Prison_4_WH, «Тюрьма: Северные камеры»), ten of them: they break out when the uprising begins and are gone when it ends.
RECOVERED creatures and place, the window's time. The prisoners of the eastern cells (Prison_5_WH, «Тюрьма: Восточные камеры»), ten of them, as the northern ones.

RECOVERED people and season, the owner's default for Абри (2026-10-12, decision 34 of its plan). NG_2014_Quest_NPC_1 and _2, «Дайсон» and «Канализационный
люк» of the New Year of 2014 (60277/60278, data/orig_names_manual.json), in Абри's Жилой квартал (Abri_Settelment): the event's people stand only in its season, 20 December to 15 January. Their quests are not built (the plan's stage 9), so in the season they stand and say nothing.

RECOVERED creature and place, the window's time. The godfather m8_uf_godfather_1, «Беглый каторжник
Хранитель общака» (60387; the wiki's page of the name: «Центральный блок»), in the centre block (Prison_3_WH). A boss: he comes once an uprising, and killed he is gone until the next one.

RECOVERED people, place and time. uf_RewardMan_1..3, «Джеф
Патологоанатом», «Аль-Назир
Коронер», «Томпсон
Судмедэксперт» (62318-62320; the wiki: «Центральный блок» тюрьмы), who take the armbands, for the last five minutes of the uprising.

held_out.why: DESIGNED. zapadlist_dvor, «Макисе Курису» (60386; the wiki: «злобный охранник, который наносит неприятные удары при помощи костыля», in the blocks a guard's way leads into), stands at the entrance of Prison_1_WH (titled «Северный блок»; west of the centre by its one opening, the wiki's «Западный блок», where the western gate leads). data/mob_types.json has it at level 20 by the highest place it stands in (the Абу-Хамед prison's), and nothing gives its level in Вади-Хальфа's: a level-20 hostile at the foot of the ladder of an m8 prison would kill whoever the gate lets in. Kept out until its level is known.
DESIGNED. The same guard at the entrance of Prison_2_WH (titled «Восточный блок»; south of the centre by its one opening, the wiki's «Южный блок», where the southern gate leads), for the same reason.

The owner's rule of 2026-10-10 («только по уровню городов») on the owner's Абри of 2026-10-12: the traders of Снаряжение Дредноута 17-18 ур and Снаряжение Паладина 19 ур (Npc_Trader000012/13, 10411/10412) sell nothing of Абри's band 8-12, so they do not stand in its clothing market (Sets_Market_Ab). The same types stand in the clothing markets of Донгола and Абу-Хамед (469, 467) as their files have them.

The owner's Абри of 2026-10-12, decision 22 of its plan: «Банкомат
Золото и серебро» (NPC_gold_craft_bank, 62143) in the smelter (OreRefinery_Abri) changed the dump's paper notes for gold (49782-49797: one note to 1.2 G and the like) -- a tap of gold with no known source of the notes, so its exchange is cut, and the machine does not stand.
The same machine in the assembly shop (OreRefinery_Abri_Sorting), for the same reason as in 766.

quests.why: RECOVERED times. The ride to the prison, «Поехали!» (62262/62263: «В 12:00, 16:00 или 23:00 отправиться в тюрьму»), and the guards' gates «Тюрьма: западные/южные ворота» (62275/62274) lead there only for the uprising, from a quarter of an hour before it.
RECOVERED. «Охранник санатория особого режима» is taken at the station any time and handed in at the prison when the guard needs hands: «Доброволец? ... Сейчас этот зоопарк полезет наружу» (62259).
RECOVERED times. «Патроны и афро владельцам склада», taken and handed in at the box only while the share-out lasts; who may take them is data/holdings.json's (data/quests.json holders).

loot.why: RECOVERED thing, DESIGNED chance. Red_Bandage, «Красная повязка ВХ» — «Красная повязка, сорванная с ваших соперников» (7323/7324): the proof the medics pay for («принесешь медикам доказательства отстрела урок», 62272). One on every prisoner and on the godfather, in the blocks only.

keep_in.why: RECOVERED rule. Томас, who leads out of the prison, «При выходе отбирает все повязки» (the wiki's «Томас»): the armbands stay in the blocks, whichever way the player leaves -- Томас's «Выход», a death sent home, a login elsewhere. DESIGNED: and no other way either -- the frame of a thing kept in carries the quest flag and no exchange (server/events.py kept, items.static_info), so no letter, lot, barter or stall takes one out, and a death does not drop it.
